title: Hand Mixer Electric, MOSAIC Mixer with attachments
text: Hand Mixer Electric, MOSAIC Mixer with attachments. Have mixed feelings on this mixer, very very small, not normal size picture is deceiving as in many items on Amazon, I ordered it because I got it half off and it's black, I guess that saying is true you get what you pay for, time will tell.
